description: Read, book, reschedule, cancel, and check availability on Cal.com — plus protect_focus_time, which auto-books a real deep-work block, and get_meeting_load, which summarizes someone's booked hours for the week.
credentials_note: Read via __rc_helpers__['vault_get']('calcom') at call time, expected shape {"api_key": "..."} — set up in Studio -> Integrations -> calcom. Never read from os.environ.

commands.name: list_bookings
commands.description: List bookings from Cal.com, optionally filtered by status.

status.help: Filter by status: upcoming, past, cancelled. Omit for all.

cursor.help: Pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

commands.name: get_booking
commands.description: Fetch a single booking by its uid.

booking_uid.help: The uid of the booking to fetch (not the numeric id).

commands.name: get_availability
commands.description: Get available time slots for an event type within a date range.

event_type_id.help: Cal.com event type ID to check availability for.

start_date.help: Start of the search window, e.g. 2026-09-01.

end_date.help: End of the search window, e.g. 2026-09-05.

timezone.help: IANA timezone for the returned slot times. Defaults to UTC.

commands.name: create_booking
commands.description: Create a new booking in Cal.com — e.g. to block focus time as a real meeting.

event_type_id.help: Cal.com event type ID to book (create one in Cal.com first, e.g. 'Focus Time').

attendee_email.help: Identifies whose calendar this books into.

length_in_minutes.help: Overrides the event type's default duration.

commands.name: reschedule_booking
commands.description: Move an existing booking to a new start time.

booking_uid.help: The uid of the booking to reschedule (not the numeric id).

reason.help: Shown to the attendee in the reschedule notification.

booking_uid.help: The uid of the booking to cancel.

reason.help: Cancellation reason shown to the attendee.

commands.name: protect_focus_time
commands.description: Find the earliest free slot for a focus-time event type in a search window and book it for real — so deep work shows up on the calendar as an actual meeting other bookings have to route around, not a suggestion someone can ignore.

event_type_id.help: Cal.com event type ID configured as the person's 'Focus Time' block.

start_date.help: Start of the search window, e.g. 2026-09-01.

end_date.help: End of the search window, e.g. 2026-09-05.

commands.name: get_meeting_load
commands.description: Summarize how many hours of upcoming bookings someone has, from already-fetched booking data — pure calculation, no extra network call.

bookings.help: The 'bookings' array as returned by list_bookings.
